ctx.x: The family seemed so musical. Musical, yeah. I wondered if it came to him for it.

Well, I don't know what's on the phrase. My father was honest when I was, no, well wait now, Salmon's daddy, Lawrence's daddy was Billy Moran, he was the number one bass player. Yeah.
